label: scenario
evidence: In commit 8aa611fc1d2acdad2b897b7feabad65d4cc561ca, Codex goal runs did not verify that thread activation returned an active goal before starting turns, and pre-activation limit snapshots (budgetLimited/usageLimited) queued before manual resume were processed as authoritative current limits by JsonRpcSession, immediately re-blocking the recovered worker. Task task-b39eb5ae-6cbc-4166-85d9-8287edbfea91 fixed this by asserting an active goal state in assertActive and filtering pre-activation notifications whose update timestamps predate manualResumeAt.
cue: Resuming, recovering, or activating external agent runner sessions (such as Codex app-server) over asynchronous RPC or event streams following a pause, stop, or rate limit.
check: Does the host integration verify that the session explicitly acknowledged an active goal before starting or steering turns, and ignore stale pre-resume limit notifications whose update timestamps strictly predate the resume request?
